questions: Whether a condition requiring a subdivision developer to set aside 30 percent of the land as open space constituted a "dedication" of land subject to constitutional takings analysis under Dolan v. City of Tigard, 512 U.S. 374, 114 S. Ct. 2309, 129 L. Ed. 2d 304 (1994).

title: State v. Williams
questions: Whether a criminal harassment statute is unconstitutionally vague, overbroad or impinging of free speech, when a term in the statute is not defined.

title: River Park Square, L.L.C.; RPS II , Washington limited liability companies; Citizens Realty Company, a Washington corporation; and U.S. Bank Trust National Association, Respondents, v. Henry Miggins, City Manager; James C. Sloane, City Attorney, Appellants, Stephen K. Eugster, Additional Appellant
questions: Whether a writ of mandamus was properly issued to require a city manager and city attorney to loan city funds pursuant to an ordinance pledging revenues for a parking garage project.
